title: Adjudication lifecycle for enterprise logging & privacy controls (redaction, retention, exports)
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create an adjudication lifecycle and decision framework for handling enterprise customer requests related to logging controls: PII redaction, retention adjustments, and audit export formats. The goal is a repeatable, SLA-driven intake flow that combines automated triage, bounded manual review, and clear engineering/product outcomes so customers get predictable responses and engineering teams have a prioritized, actionable queue.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A documented scoring rubric that ranks requests by compliance risk, customer SLA tier, volume impact, and implementation complexity. 2) A single-page intake form and response templates for the three request classes (redaction, retention, export). 3) An automated triage prototype that labels incoming requests and suggests priority. 4) Playbook with timelines (acknowledgement SLO, evaluation SLO, resolution SLO) and escalation paths. 5) Pilot with two enterprise customers and internal runbook for on-call rotation.
status_updates: 2025-02-10: Ticket opened; scoped initial problem statement and identified stakeholders (Security, Legal, Serving, Console).

2025-02-17: Scoring rubric v0 drafted with Product and Security: factors = {compliance_risk, customer_tier, request_volume, infra_impact, implementation_effort}. Action: engineering to validate infra_impact estimates for common request archetypes.

2025-02-24: Design review: Intake form wireframe reviewed — requested fields: customer_org, environment, sample_log_snippet (redacted by customer), requested_sla, business_justification. Design asked to add guidance toggles for common patterns.

2025-03-01: Infra validation meeting with Serving team: KV-cache and batching not impacted for retention-only changes, but redaction at ingestion requires a new pre-processing hook. Engineering estimates: 3 weeks for a lightweight preprocessor + feature flag rollout; 6 weeks for deep integration with Dedicated. Marked implementation complexity as medium-high.
2025-03-03: Legal and Security provided review notes: exports must include audit trail metadata; retention exceptions require documented legal approval. Added security_review_required flag.

2025-03-05: Prototype triage rules implemented in Zendesk/Linear connector (rule-based): if request mentions PII or export format => high priority; if retention < 90 days for non-PII => medium. Pilot onboarding planned for week of 2025-03-10.
Follow ups: schedule customer pilot onboarding, finalize SLA timelines, author engineering RFC for ingestion preprocessor, and add runbook to Confluence.
proposed_solution_summary: Deliver a three-stage adjudication pipeline: (1) Automated intake + scoring that assigns triage label and SLO suggestion, (2) Product/Security review lane for high-risk items with templated legal checklists, (3) Engineering implementation lane with standardized change templates, rollout flags, and monitoring. Provide response templates and timeboxes: Acknowledge (24h), Evaluation (5 business days), Resolution or Next Steps (15 business days) with customers able to upgrade to expedited SLA plans.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): finalize rubric, intake form, response templates, and triage rules; Phase 2 (3 weeks): build lightweight triage automation and Confluence runbook; Phase 3 (4-6 weeks): engineering spike + preprocessor prototype behind feature flag; Phase 4 (4 weeks): customer pilot with two enterprise customers, collect metrics for correctness, latency of response, and engineer cycle time; Phase 5: iterate and ship to production with telemetry and dashboarding.
risk_and_mitigations: Risk: Underestimating engineering effort for redaction at ingestion. Mitigation: scope a lightweight preprocessor first, require feature flag and gradual rollout to Dedicated customers.
Risk: Legal approvals create unbounded delays. Mitigation: build an approval SLA and pre-authorized templates for low-risk retention changes.
Risk: Automation mislabels high-risk items. Mitigation: human-in-loop for all 'high' labels during pilot and logging of triage accuracy metrics.
Risk: Customers expect faster timelines. Mitigation: offer paid expedited SLA and clearly communicate trade-offs in intake response template.
